status: Exploratory control completion after the original cell/Bliss comparison; before fitting the additional dose-based baseline.
reason: The declared dose/monotherapy error control was not included in the first implementation. Preserve its original comparisons and add this sensitivity without replacing the primary result.
baseline: Ridge regression (alpha=20) of log(1+squared error) on cell indicators, mean log10 endpoint dose, absolute endpoint log-dose difference and Bliss reference/100. Continuous features standardized using calibration training rows only. This is monotone in each transformed continuous feature conditional on other features; fitted directions are unconstrained. Rescale back-transformed predictions to training mean squared error, floor at 1e-8. Fit separate calibrators for row error and error of pair-cell means.
selection: Add this baseline to the original three candidates, choose using the existing fixed half-validation-pair split, then refit all validation pairs. Outcomes from test rows never choose a baseline or its scale.
metric: Paired top-10% error-mass gain of uncertainty over the augmented selected baseline, whole-pair bootstrap and drug jackknife. Same +5 percentage-point material-effect rule as the original protocol.
negative_result: Failure against either original or augmented controls does not establish practical value from model-specific uncertainty. No additional architecture or calibration search.
